headline: Report says Chinese spy may have targeted Nvidia CEO through close associate
summary: A new report alleges a Chinese intelligence asset targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang through a senior executive at a Singapore-based Nvidia cloud partner already accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China, who is suspected of passing information to Beijing. Separately, the reporting says President Trump had intelligence on the matter but chose not to act, with one outlet attributing his inaction to protecting the company's stock.
